summary: Combo (A+B+C+D) regression complete. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases PASS against MongoDB-backed routes (/api/creators/list, /api/creators/add, /api/creators/:username, /api/creators/remove, /api/analytics/status, /api/analytics/creators, /api/analytics/creator/darkskully + /events + /top-gifters + /recent-gifts + /viewer-trends + /streams, 404 path). Seeded creators darkskully & streamerqueen present; 8 events for darkskully; 404 on nonexistent works. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): 19 of 20 swapped+Batch-3 routes render the God Tier enhanced screens correctly with the floating cyan [data-testid='god-tier-metrics-badge'] visible. Badge click on /battles successfully navigates to /god-tier-metrics (hero 'God Tier Metrics' rendered, badge correctly hidden on that screen). Interactions verified: battles-filter-active filters list (Active tab keeps 2 LIVE battles), battle-history-search-input narrows the list (@ tokens went 9 -> 3 when searching 'darkskully'), global-leaderboard-timeframe-month toggles to cyan active state. /fans now shows real backend chips @darkskully and @streamerqueen pulled from /api/creators/list. CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG: /dashboard hard-crashes inside GodTierErrorBoundary with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading toLocaleString)' because dashboard.tsx:217 reads displayStats.total_viewers but the /api/analytics/status endpoint only returns {eventsProcessed,lastProcessedAt,errors,isRunning} - no total_viewers/live_now fields. MINOR: /analytics logs 'analyticsAPI.getTopGifters is not a function' (and getRevenueHistory) - these methods are missing from /app/frontend/src/services/api.ts but the screen survives and shows zeros. Trends screen renders but emits SVG negative-width warnings (viewBox '0 0 -64 200') from chart sizing.

ui_bugs.issue: Crashes inside GodTierErrorBoundary: TypeError 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading toLocaleString)' at line 217. displayStats falls back to apiStats from /api/analytics/status whose shape is {success, stats:{eventsProcessed,lastProcessedAt,errors,isRunning}} - it has no .total_viewers / .live_now. Need to either (a) point useApiCall at a real summary endpoint that returns total_viewers/live_now, or (b) optional-chain & default: `(displayStats?.total_viewers ?? 0).toLocaleString()` and `displayStats?.live_now ?? 0`. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/dashboard.tsx:217,230

Calls analyticsAPI.getTopGifters(10) and analyticsAPI.getRevenueHistory(7) but neither method is exported from /app/frontend/src/services/api.ts (only getStreamAnalytics, getActivityFeed, getStreamMilestones, getCreatorMilestones, getFollowerGrowth, getRevenueAnalytics, getCoinAnalytics, getChatAnalytics, getHistoricalData defined). Screen does not crash thanks to try/catch but always shows $0/0/0. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/analytics.tsx:68-69 vs /app/frontend/src/services/api.ts:101-144

Console warnings 'svg attribute width: A negative value is not valid (-64)' and 'viewBox 0 0 -64 200' - chart computes negative dimensions on narrow mobile width. Visual still renders but indicates a sizing bug. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/trends.tsx (chart width calc)

rca_of_issue: dashboard.tsx defines `const displayStats = !isConnected && cachedStats ? cachedStats : (apiStats || stats);`. apiStats originates from useApiCall against /api/analytics/status which returns `{success:true, stats:{eventsProcessed,lastProcessedAt,errors,isRunning}}`. The actual `stats` object the screen needs comes from useDashboard() but apiStats truthy-falls-through wins. When rendering line 217 reads `displayStats.total_viewers.toLocaleString()`. total_viewers is undefined -> TypeError -> caught by GodTierErrorBoundary which renders 'Something went wrong'. Reproduction: navigate to /dashboard, see error boundary screen. Mitigation: change line 217/230 to `(displayStats?.total_viewers ?? 0).toLocaleString()` / `displayStats?.live_now ?? 0`, or change the useApiCall URL to the dashboard summary endpoint that actually returns those fields.
